question: Question linked to image nº15 A 67-year-old patient who reported a decrease in unilateral visual acuity and rapidly evolving metamorphopsia. The attached retinography presents the image of the affected eye. The most likely diagnosis would be:

options.opa: Macular degeneration associated with exudative age.
